sections.text_helper: Section 25.4.5 "CCB error management" in chapter 25 (Coupling and chaining bridge (CCB)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 752.
sections.section_content:
When the CCB detects an error during a coupling and chaining operation (see
Section25.5), it sets accordingly OPERR[5:0] in CCB_SR (see Section25.7.2 for the
possible errors).
When OPERR[5:0]≠0 in CCB_SR, the CCB raises IPRST in CCB_CR, sets OPSTEP[4:0]
to 0x1F, and sets CCB_BUSY bit to 1. The application must clear IPRST to be able to use
again the CCB and the peripheral(s) used by the coupling and chaining operation.
